items.title: Firebase read quota exceeded during fest
items.body: Attendance scanning stopped for about 40 minutes on fest day because the Firebase free tier read quota was exceeded at 11:00.

comments_data.body: Free tier is 50k reads/day and fest day blew through it before noon. We need a database that can handle spikes.

items.title: Login redirect loop after Google Sign-In
items.body: After signing in with Google, some users are sent back to the login page in a loop.

items.title: Migrate backend from Firebase to Supabase
items.body: Moves auth data, events and attendance tables to Supabase Postgres. Push notifications stay on Firebase Cloud Messaging because Supabase has no push service. Closes #28.

comments_data.body: Approving. Reason for the move is in #28 and the 12 Sep tech sync notes: quota limits, and we need SQL for the HoD attendance reports.

items.title: Fix login redirect loop
items.body: Fixes the redirect loop by clearing the stale session cookie before redirect. Closes #29.

items.title: QR scan fails on iOS Safari
items.body: On iPhones using Safari the QR scanner shows a black screen and attendance cannot be marked.

comments_data.body: Happened again at the workshop, third time this month. Workaround: clear Safari cache or use Chrome. Root cause unknown, I suspect camera permission caching.

items.title: Push notifications for event reminders
items.body: Adds event reminder notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging.

comments_data.body: Blocked: FCM is rate limiting our bulk test sends. Need to batch the sends before this can merge.

items.title: Integrate college SSO (CAS)
items.body: College IT mandates CAS single sign-on for all student apps from next semester, replacing Google Sign-In. Contact: Vikram Rao (vikram.rao@college.edu). Target: 15 Dec.

comments_data.body: IT will issue CAS credentials only after their security audit. New target is 10 Jan.
